title: A zoom into the Mandelbrot set, on the GPU
hook: A hundred thousand times closer to the edge of the Mandelbrot set, every pixel iterated on the GPU, until 32-bit floats run out of digits.
alt: The black-bodied Mandelbrot set glows at its edge in bands of two colors while the view dives toward a point on the boundary, where spirals and filaments open up, and pulls back out. Engaged, the view can be panned and zoomed by hand.
author: @escape.time

pointer.hint: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · double-click to zoom in

targets.note: On the CPU at half resolution, with at most 200 iterations.

presets.label: Seahorse valley at 1000 iterations
presets.note: At zoom 10^4 the slow-escaping points near the boundary resolve into spirals instead of a blob.

presets.label: 50 iterations, the budget shows
presets.note: Too few iterations: points that escape late are drawn as if they were in the set.

presets.label: A three-armed branch point
presets.note: Near c ≈ −0.1011 + 0.9563i three filaments meet. Almost every pixel escapes: the set is very thin here.
